title: Joey Porter Sr says former Steelers teammate Ben Roethlisberger is not ‘a good person’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joey Porter Sr says former Steelers teammate Ben Roethlisberger is not ‘a good person’
sources.description: Joey Porter Sr says Ben Roethlisberger, the quarterback he won a Super Bowl with at the Pittsburgh Steelers, is not “a good person”. Porter was speaking on a podcast during Super Bowl week when he made the comments. Porter said Roethlisberger and another former Steeler, James Harrison, had broken a code by criticizing Mike Tomlin, who departed as Pittsburgh head coach in January after 19 seasons in charge, on their own podcasts.
